text.7:109: The chiefs of Pharaoh's people said: Lo! this is some knowing wizard,
text.7:112: To bring each knowing wizard unto thee.
text.7:113: And the wizards came to Pharaoh, saying: Surely there will be a reward for us if we are victors.
text.7:120: And the wizards fell down prostrate,
text.10:2: Is it a wonder for mankind that We have inspired a man among them, saying: Warn mankind and bring unto those who believe the good tidings that they have a sure footing with their Lord? The disbelievers say: Lo! this is a mere wizard.
text.10:77: Moses said: Speak ye (so) of the Truth when it hath come unto you? Is this magic? Now magicians thrive not.
text.10:79: And Pharaoh said: Bring every cunning wizard unto me.
text.10:80: And when the wizards came, Moses said unto them: Cast your cast!
text.20:63: They said: Lo! these are two wizards who would drive you out from your country by their magic, and destroy your best traditions;
text.20:69: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain.
text.20:70: Then the wizards were (all) flung down prostrate, crying: We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.
text.26:34: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,
text.26:38: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.
text.26:40: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.
text.26:41: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?
text.26:46: And the wizards were flung prostrate,
text.38:4: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.
text.40:24: Unto Pharaoh and Haman and Korah, but they said: A lying sorcerer!
text.43:49: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.
text.51:39: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
text.51:52: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
